name: domain-rag-citation-evaluation-workflow
description: Use when a fixed set of agricultural policy questions must be decomposed, grounded in local and web evidence, answered with deterministic source citations, and scored from human answer and citation annotations.

name: objective-aligned-t5-few-shot-workflow
